backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md core multi-window protocol plus Space frozen snapshots

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies. Forward replacement profiles come from closed 2026 event-state ledger rows, so any helper remains default-off metadata and live Space slots stay zero.

attention_overlay_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

government_contract_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_depth.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

single_event_defense_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

gate_questions.q1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: haircut only Space tickers whose mature non-attention 10d forward profile is negative on cash-relative PnL or same-theme replacement value.
q2_prior_experiments: exp-20260513-113 accepted 10d cash-positive plus same-theme-positive risk at 1.05x.
exp-20260514-009 accepted the 10d same-theme strength trend-only interaction at 1.05x.
exp-20260514-011 rejected 5d confirmation because it regressed mid_weak and only old_thin improved.
No prior logged Space experiment tested the mirror negative 10d replacement-profile haircut.
gate_questions.q3_single_causal_variable: Only the negative-profile risk scalar changes; entries, exits, ranking, targets, LLM/news, tickers, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.q4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown damage <= 0.5pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 aggregate trades, and real adjusted signals.

hypothesis: Space forward replacement profiles should be useful on both sides of allocation. Official non-attention Space tickers whose mature 10d forward profile has negative cash-relative PnL or negative same-theme replacement value may deserve a default-off risk haircut on top of the accepted exp-20260514-009 stack.
known_risks: The Space sleeve remains default-off and historical Space snapshots are frozen research copies.
Negative forward profiles are sparse and ticker-concentrated, especially ASTS/PL.
Accepted results would still be observation metadata, not live Space slot enablement.
next_evidence_needed: Do not promote negative forward replacement-profile risk from this frozen replay. Use more closed forward rows or a different catalyst-quality axis.

locked_variables: all prior accepted Space risk helpers

rejection_reason: No tested negative-profile risk scalar improved aggregate EV/PnL across the three windows without a window-level EV regression, drawdown or survival violation, or zero-adjustment result.
single_causal_variable: extra risk scalar for official Space tickers whose mature 10d forward event-state profile is negative on cash-relative PnL or same-theme replacement value
why_not_other_changes: 20d forward persistence had only one mature official non-attention ticker/event, so it was too data-limited. LLM soft-ranking remains label-thin and ticker expansion risks adding noise, so this tests a structured 10d replacement-value allocation field instead.
